# Product Requirements Document (PRD)

## 1. Meta & Traceability
- **Title**: [Feature/Project Name]
- **Tracking GitHub Issue**: [#<id>](https://github.com/org/repo/issues/<id>)
- **GitHub Project Card**: [Project Link](https://github.com/users/.../projects/...)
- **Target Branch**: `feature/issue-#<id>-<slug>`
- **C4 Architecture Model**: [Link to Architecture Model](wiki/Architecture)
- **Author(s)**: [Name / Agent]
- **Status**: [Draft / In Review / Approved / Shipped]
- **Target Release / Milestone**: [Version / Date]

## 2. Problem Alignment (The "Why")
- **Problem Statement**: What specific user problem are we solving?
- **Target Audience**: Who are we building this for? (Segments, personas)
- **Value Proposition**: How does this improve the user's life or workflow?
- **Business Goal**: How does this align with company OKRs? (e.g., Retention, Engagement, Revenue)

## 3. Scope & Requirements (The "What")
### In Scope
- [Requirement 1: Describe the capability from the user's perspective]
- [Requirement 2]

### Out of Scope (Non-Goals)
- [Explicitly state what we are NOT doing in this iteration]

## 4. User Experience & Flows
- **Entry Point**: How does the user discover this feature?
- **Happy Path**: Step-by-step flow of successful usage.
- **Edge Cases & Error Handling**: What happens when things go wrong? (e.g., network failure, invalid input)

## 5. Metrics & Success (The "How we measure")
- **Primary Metric**: What is the single most important metric? (e.g., Adoption rate)
- **Secondary Metrics**: What else are we tracking?
- **Guardrail Metrics**: What metrics must NOT regress? (e.g., Page load time, crash rate)

## 6. Go-To-Market & Rollout
- **Rollout Plan**: [e.g., 10% Canary -> 50% Beta -> 100% GA]
- **Dependencies**: Any marketing, legal, or cross-team dependencies?

## 7. Open Questions
- [Question 1: Who needs to resolve this?]
